content:
Is there anybody maintaining RepresentationTheory.AlgebraRepresentation? The content so far contains only Schur's lemma: one for finite dimensional representations and another for abelian groups. I want to push a refactor PR to weaken the finite dimensional condition, which is necessary for smooth representation theory where irreducibles satisfy Schur but usually are not finite dim.

The problem is that the docstring of RepresentationTheory.AlgebraRepresentation is 

/-!
# Basic facts about algebra representations

This file collects basic general facts about algebra representations. The purpose of this file is
to have general results so that when we prove a corresponding fact about group representations
(or Lie algebra representations etc), we can deduce them as special cases of facts from this file.

-/
This was my very first or second PR, and I don't claim that I knew what I'm doing
Would it be possible to state the general version in this file and just change the proof of this Schur's lemma to follow from the more general version?
Yes #42079. I didn't change your structure or the above docstring so you still have the authorship. It's a minimal modification I believe. Does it look good to you?
